competences: The learner read a passage about future plans.
The learner answer comprehension questions in complete sentences.
languageCompetence: Pronounces, reads, spells and uses correctly: zoo, chimpanzees, monkeys, pancakes, evening.
objectives: By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to read a passage about future plans.
By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to answer comprehension questions in complete sentences.
priorKnowledge: Learners use will and shall to describe future actions.
references: P 4 ENG & SST Lesson Notes Term III 2023

steps.content: Learners use will and shall to describe future actions. Key words: zoo, chimpanzees, monkeys, pancakes, evening
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher displays complete akot reading passage chart and links the chart to the prior knowledge: Learners use will and shall to describe future actions. The teacher pronounces the lesson vocabulary, checks learners’ reading, and introduces reading: akot’s plan to go to the zoo.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners recall familiar words, read the displayed key words aloud, and explain what they already know about the topic.

source.quote: AKOT’S PLAN TO GO TO THE ZOO

steps.stage: Development: Akot’s plan to go to the zoo
steps.content: Akot’s plan to go to the zoo: Next Sunday, my sister Joyce and I will visit the zoo. We shall see many animals and birds. We shall see lions, chimpanzees and monkeys. We shall not see elephants because they are not in the zoo. On our way, we shall eat pancakes and drink soda. We shall take bananas for chimpanzees and monkeys.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher models reading of this content: Next Sunday, my sister Joyce and I will visit the zoo. We shall see many animals and birds. We shall see lions, chimpanzees and monkeys. We shall not see elephants because they are not in the zoo. On our way, we shall eat pancakes and drink soda. We shall take bananas for chimpanzees and monkeys. The teacher checks pronunciation and meaning, draws attention to the target wording, and asks: "With whom will Akot go to the zoo?" Learners’ responses are checked against the displayed text.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners read the source sentences or entries aloud, identify the target words, answer the teacher’s question, and copy the stated content accurately.

source.quote: AKOT’S PLAN TO GO TO THE ZOO

steps.content: Returning home: We shall come back home in the evening, very tired. We shall bathe with warm water. After that, we shall go to bed to rest. We shall wake up early and go to school the next day.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher models reading of this content: We shall come back home in the evening, very tired. We shall bathe with warm water. After that, we shall go to bed to rest. We shall wake up early and go to school the next day. The teacher checks pronunciation and meaning, draws attention to the target wording, and asks: "What will they eat on their way to the zoo?" Learners’ responses are checked against the displayed text.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners read the source sentences or entries aloud, identify the target words, answer the teacher’s question, and copy the stated content accurately.

steps.stage: Development: Example: answering in a full sentence
steps.content: Example: answering in a full sentence: When will Akot go to the zoo? Akot will go to the zoo next Sunday.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher models reading of this content: When will Akot go to the zoo? Akot will go to the zoo next Sunday. The teacher checks pronunciation and meaning, draws attention to the target wording, and asks: "Why will they not see the elephants at the zoo?" Learners’ responses are checked against the displayed text.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners read the source sentences or entries aloud, identify the target words, answer the teacher’s question, and copy the stated content accurately.

source.quote: When will Akot go to the zoo

steps.content: With whom will Akot go to the zoo? What will they eat on their way to the zoo? Why will they not see the elephants at the zoo? What will they take for the chimpanzees and the monkeys? How many people will go to the zoo next Sunday?
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher gives the following sourced text-based exercise: With whom will Akot go to the zoo? What will they eat on their way to the zoo? Why will they not see the elephants at the zoo? What will they take for the chimpanzees and the monkeys? How many people will go to the zoo next Sunday? The teacher checks learners’ written answers for meaning, spelling and punctuation, using this key: Akot will go to the zoo with Akot’s sister Joyce. They will eat pancakes on their way to the zoo. They will not see elephants because there are no elephants in the zoo. They will take bananas for the chimpanzees and monkeys. Two people, Akot and Joyce, will go to the zoo.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners answer individually in their books, use full sentences when required, read selected answers aloud, and correct spelling or punctuation after feedback.

source.quote: With whom will Akot go to the zoo

steps.content: Key answers: Akot will go to the zoo with Akot’s sister Joyce. They will eat pancakes on their way to the zoo. They will not see elephants because there are no elephants in the zoo. They will take bananas for the chimpanzees and monkeys. Two people, Akot and Joyce, will go to the zoo.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher revisits these questions: With whom will Akot go to the zoo? What will they eat on their way to the zoo? Why will they not see the elephants at the zoo? The teacher checks whether learners have met the objectives, explains any remaining errors using the source text, and assigns the final exercise item for correction.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners explain their answers with evidence from the text, read corrected sentences aloud, and note the final item for homework.

source.quote: How many people will go to the zoo next Sunday

assessment: Check oral reading and written responses to these questions: With whom will Akot go to the zoo? What will they eat on their way to the zoo? Why will they not see the elephants at the zoo? Mark meaning, spelling, sentence structure and punctuation against the displayed source models.
homework: Complete or correct the following source exercise item, writing the answer neatly: How many people will go to the zoo next Sunday?
